newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia C.bank says has $10 bln to support rouble.
newsitem.headline: Russia C.bank says has $10 bln to support rouble.

text.p: Russia's central bank has $10 billion to use in foreign exchange market intervention in case of sharp fluctuations in the rouble's rate against the dollar, the deputy head of the central bank told Reuters.
"We always keep about $10 billion on our accounts ready for any unplanned fluctuations (on the foreign exchange market)," Alexander Potyomkin said.
Potyomkin said demand for dollars from commercial banks had been high since the end of December, but that the increase in demand was traditional for this period.
"If there is any additional demand for hard currency, we will have no problems with satisfying it," he said.
Central bank officials said last November that the bank's gross foreign exchange and gold reserves were about $16 billion.
